 Pop Culture News ‘Call Her Daddy’ host Alex Cooper welcomes her first baby
 Cooper announced her son’s birth on Instagram. The Unwell founder didn’t reveal the name or birth date of her baby with husband Matt Kaplan. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Alex Cooper. Julien M. Hekimian / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 20, 2026, 11:18 AM EDT By Rebecca Cohen Alex Cooper, the host of “Call Her Daddy,” is now a mom. 
 Cooper, 32, announced the birth of her first child, a boy, in an Instagram post Tuesday . The Unwell founder and her husband, Matt Kaplan, 42, announced in May that they were expecting . The baby’s due date was not clear. 
 The post featured a photo of a newborn in a fuzzy blue outfit. The caption was just a blue heart. 
 On Thursday, Cooper posted a slideshow of photos from her pregnancy. 
 “The most transformative 9 months of my life,” she wrote in the caption.
 In a July post on Instagram , Cooper revealed that she was diagnosed with gestational diabetes, which she described as “when the placenta hormones cause insulin resistance — aka your pancreas cannot create enough insulin to keep your blood sugar normal.”
 At first, Cooper said, she was hard on herself about the diagnosis, which she said felt “very isolating.” But ultimately, she said, she just wanted her baby to be healthy.
